source_text: Προσήγαγον Πιλάτῳ τὸν Ἰησοῦν· παρεδόθησαν καὶ αὐτοὶ ταῖς Ῥωμαίων στρατιαῖς. καὶ πεπλήρωται τὰ διὰ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν ἐπ' αὐτοῖς προαπηγγελμένα· ὁ μὲν γάρ φησιν· "οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνόμῳ· πονηρὰ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ συμβήσεται αὐτῷ". ὁ δέ· καθὼς "ἐποίησας, οὕτως ἔσται σοι· τὸ ἀνταπόδομά σου ἀνταποδοθήσεται εἰς τὴν κεφαλήν σου".
pass_a_gloss: They-brought to Pilate the Jesus; were-handed-over also themselves to the of-Romans armies. And has-been-fulfilled the through the holy prophets upon them having-been-foretold; the on-the-one-hand says: 'woe to the lawless; evil things according-to the works of him will-happen to him'. But the: as 'you-did, thus will-be to-you; the recompense of you will-be-repaid into the head of you'.
pass_b_english: They brought Jesus to Pilate — and they themselves were handed over to the Roman armies. And what was foretold about them through the holy prophets has been fulfilled. One says, “Woe to the lawless; evils will come upon him according to his works.” Another: “As you did, so it will be to you; your recompense will be repaid on your head.”
